subject: CRM hygiene: SKU & amounts reconciliation ahead of finance review
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: CRM hygiene: SKU & amounts reconciliation ahead of finance review

Team —

Finance is running the weekly revenue forecast on Friday (May 28). Before they lock numbers I need a quick, targeted CRM sweep so the forecast reflects our current view. The ask is small but high-impact: for any open opportunity > $25k, please update these CRM fields by EOD Wednesday (May 26):

- Amount (net ARR or ACV as agreed with customer)
- Product / SKU (use the latest SKU map — link below)
- Next step (1–2 sentence status: PO pending, legal review, pilot, etc.)
- Probability (adjusted to your current go/no-go estimate)
- Close date (if pushed, set to the honest date; we will roll if needed)

I attached a quick export of current open opps filtered by owner (open_opps_20260524.csv). Prioritize: HXL-489 (HelixAI), VERT-311, and NOVA-128. If you need me to call an account owner or sync with Finance, I can.

Checklist (copy back when done):
- Updated CRM fields for prioritized opps
- Confirm any amount changes with purchaser contact (if >10% delta)
- Add a one-line note in the opp timeline referencing this sweep

Why this matters: Finance will use CRM amounts for the committed column in the board forecast. Incomplete SKUs and stale amounts create avoidable churn in our ACV estimate.

Links: SKU map (drive) and finance template are below.

Thanks —

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: open_opps_20260524.csv (CSV export of open opportunities)

- VERT-311: updated SKU to Enterprise-Std, amount stays $42,000, next step = legal SOW review. Probability 50%.

I pinged Megan to confirm the PO ETA and asked for a copy so Legal can start the minor SOW changes. If I get the PO before EOD Weds I’ll mark HXL-489 commit; otherwise I’ll move close date to 2026-06-15.

Appreciate the quick turn here — this is exactly the granularity Finance needs. A couple of asks from my side before we close the book:

- Please use the finance template (Drive link) when you update amounts so our script ingests correctly. I uploaded a cleaned CSV template here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSKUmap
- If any amount changed > 10% vs the last committed value, add a one-line justification in the opp timeline (so audit can trace changes).
- For any opp with external procurement/legal dependencies (e.g., HXL-489), add the external contact in the CRM contact list (email) so we can follow up if needed.

We’ll run the commit numbers on Thursday morning and share a pre-board snapshot on Thursday evening. If you don’t finish updates by Wed EOD, Finance will show last-known committed amount with an asterisk and we will exclude from the committed column.

Thanks —

Sean Gallagher
Revenue Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
